newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska buys U.S. Beacon Construction.
newsitem.headline: Skanska buys U.S. Beacon Construction.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska on Thursday said it had acquired Boston-based building firm Beacon Construction, strengthening its position in the U.S. construction market.
"The acquisition is an important step into the fast growing Boston area," Skanska (USA) Inc president Claes Bjork said in a statement.
He said Beacon Construction, previously a subsidiary of the real estate group Beacon Properties, had an annual turnover of $100 million and 100-person staff.
Bjork said Skanska already had a presence in Boston through its subsidiary Slattery which is involved in one part of a motorway construction project worth $10 billion.
